---
title: "09 · Tracing, observability, and replay"
---

What would let another person reconstruct a decision?

## Concepts

Record meaningful events with stable run and step IDs, parentage, inputs, outcomes, and resource usage. Use captured observations for replay and carry evidence references when excluding sensitive payloads.

## Study task

Map the trial ledger to ordered events. Replay the decisions after a simulated interruption and identify which facts the current report cannot reconstruct.

## Deliverable

Submit a trace schema, a redaction rule, and the minimum record needed to explain why a candidate was kept.

## Companion reading

- *Building Applications with AI Agents*, chapter 10, for production instrumentation, monitoring, and regression traces [@albada2025applications].
